title: rs_crossexam_falsifier_result_response
description: Structured output for the cross-examiner of the readiness-score falsifier. Judge whether the claimed gating defect survives the other evaluators' anonymized evidence, and revise the falsifier's confidence.

revised_confidence.description: The revised 0-100 confidence that the falsifier's gating defect is real. Reported in the verdict summary; it is not averaged into the aggregate readiness score.

delta.description: revised_confidence minus the falsifier's original confidence. Negative when cross-examination lowered the confidence.

most_damaging_finding.description: The falsifier's claimed defect, or whichever finding across the results is most damaging if true. Quote it.

verdict_on_finding.description: Whether the falsifier's gating defect survives the other evaluators' evidence.

resolution_known.description: True only if a concrete resolution to the defect exists (a known hook or a one-line plan amendment) derivable from the evaluators' findings. False otherwise.

resolution.description: The resolution/blocking amendment when resolution_known is true, else an empty string.
